title: Streifenskunk (Tiergarten Delitzsch) (7)
author: Fiver, der Hellseher
changes: The sound track of a video of a striped skunk (Mephitis mephitis) at Tiergarten Delitzsch zoo, Germany: the skunk rustling, scrabbling and snuffling about in its enclosure (no vocal call; skunks are mostly quiet). Trimmed to 0.10–3.00 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
